personality_one_liner: A premium, clean, and trustworthy e-commerce experience that puts the product at the absolute center.

spacing.rule: Use 8pt grid system. Maintain generous spacing between distinct functional blocks. Ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.

do's: Use on the pager indicator pill over the hero image
Use on the Wishlist FAB inside the hero card
Use on the sticky bottom action bar (Add to Cart / Buy Now) to allow content to slide underneath
dont's: Do not use on standard list items or cards
Do not use on variant chips

screens.name: Product Detail Page
screens.purpose: A high-conversion product display screen that showcases images flawlessly, handles variant selection elegantly, and presents dense specs cleanly.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for the hero card and specification rows, retaining the layout footprint.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty box with 'Product not found', and a 'Back to Shop' CTA.
states.error: Readable error message stating 'Unable to load product details' with a prominent 'Retry' button.

screens.layout:
1. SCREEN ROOT: Use a ScrollView with a sticky bottom container outside of it for actions. Set ScrollView background to surfaceSecondary (#FAF9F6). Apply safe area to top and bottom.
2. BREADCRUMBS: Subtle row at the top (under header), textMuted, sm size.
3. HERO CARD: Inset card with margin lg (16px) left/right. Background surface. Radius md (12px), subtle shadow (tier 1). Image height ~340px, aspect ratio 4:5 or 1:1. Use resizeMode: 'contain' with padding inside the Image container so phone edges are NEVER cut off. 
4. HERO OVERLAYS: Wishlist FAB top-right (glass or solid white). Pager indicator bottom-right (glass pill, e.g., '1/5'). 
5. THUMBNAILS: Below hero card, a horizontally scrolling list of 48x48 rounded squares (radius sm). Active state has a 2px borderStrong outline.
6. TITLE & PRICE: Housed in a surface card. Price uses xl or 2xl typography with a smaller 'from' prefix aligned to baseline or stacked directly above in textMuted.
7. BOX SYSTEM: All subsequent sections (RAM/Storage, Quantity, Details, Specs, Reviews) use identical cards: outer margin lg, inner padding lg, radius md, background surface, 1px border. Vertical gap between cards is md (12px). Section headers are 12px uppercase, textMuted, letter spacing 0.5px.
8. VARIANT CHIPS: Flex-wrap grid with gap sm (8px). Selected: brandPrimary 1.5px border, brandSecondary (light green) background. Unselected: 1px border outline, transparent bg. Out-of-stock: dashed border, opacity 0.5. Include sub-text in chips for price hints.
9. TEXT ALIGNMENT: Key-value rows (Specs/Details): left align label, right align value. IF value exceeds 20 characters (like long network bands), stack them vertically (label top, value bottom left-aligned) to prevent ragged text wrapping. Empty values show '—' in textMuted.
10. BOTTOM BAR: Sticky bottom container. Glassmorphism enabled. Two equal width buttons (flex 1) separated by md gap. Left button: Outlined 'Add to Cart' (brandPrimary border & text). Right button: Filled 'Buy Now' (brandPrimary bg, white text). Button heights must be minimum 48pt.

instructions_to_main_agent: Fix Image Cropping: The current hero carousel cuts off edges. Use resizeMode: 'contain' inside a square container with padding (e.g., p-4 or p-6) so the entire device is always visible. The container should be an inset card, not full-bleed.

Implement Box System: All sections (Variants, Quantity, Specs, Reviews) must share the exact same container style: surface background, lg margin horizontal, lg padding internal, md radius, and a 1px border (#E5E5E5). Do not mix flat rows with bordered cards.
Text Wrapping Rules: Do not allow long spec values to right-align and wrap awkwardly. Check length, and if it wraps, change flex direction to column with left-alignment. Display empty specs as '—'.
Variant Chip States: Selected state gets brandPrimary border and brandSecondary background. Ensure price delta is visible in 10px text underneath the size.

Sticky Bottom Bar: Use a fixed container at the bottom (outside the ScrollView) that incorporates safe area insets. Make sure the ScrollView has adequate bottom padding so content doesn't hide behind the sticky bar.
Use Phosphor icons consistently, outlined for regular items, filled for active/selected states.
